newsitem.title: USA: Dataquest sees personal computer market growing.
newsitem.headline: Dataquest sees personal computer market growing.

text.p: Dataquest said Tuesday it expects the personal computer market to grow 19 percent in 1997, with shipments surpassing 84.3 million units.
Dataquest also said the market will continue to post double-digit growth through the year 2001 with shipments reaching 151.6 million units.
Market research and consulting company Dataquest is a Gartner Group company.
Dataquest said the PC war between Dell Computer Corp and other vendors will change the industry landscape forever.
It said the challenge is for the PC manufacturers to accelerate inventory turnover and increase return on investment.
